paper_id: Xiao et al. - 2006 - A design of overlay anonymous multicast protocol
title: A Design of Overlay Anonymous Multicast Protocol
motivation: Overlay multicast即将部署,但安全功能(匿名性)缺失,军事/紧急应用急需发送方和接收方双向匿名
problem_framing: 将匿名多播定义为空Overlay匿名多播树,需同时满足匿名度,传输效率,分布式自组织和增量优化
key_insight: 匿名多播的核心必须围绕树的构建,unica单播方案不能直接套用
method_signature: MAM协议:单向匿名协议+双向匿名协议+匿名多播树构建与IT阈值触发MO节点邀请
evaluation_criteria: P_reveal(匿名度),RRU(相对资源消耗),AWD(最坏延迟)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: AM节点过多时性能严重下降,即使最优方案也退化为naïve RAND,且AM-AM连接代价至少两倍于AM-NM连接
evidence_for_taste: the potential solution to anonymous multicast must center on the concept of the tree
A larger m will provide a higher anonymity degree while incurring larger cost and latency
AM sender anonymity improves when the tree grows
MAM may be directly used with no need to invite MO nodes
inviting more MO nodes is not as effective as before
thinking_moves: 把匿名多播的挑战归结为树的暴露问题,而非路径问题
通过IT阈值机制把AM-AM连接控制在性能可接受范围
用incomplete tree在带宽效率和匿名度之间做工程折中
从攻击者视角(break-in概率)形式化定义匿名度度量
cites_own_work: Xiao et al. 2003 - Low-cost and Reliable Mutual Anonymity Protocols
